name: Jehubbah
overview: Jehubbah was a male member of the tribe of Asher, known primarily as the son of Shomer. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture provides no additional information or notable events concerning his life or role.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Jehubbah' appears as a proper name in Scripture without an accompanying meaning or divine attribution. It is simply recorded as is in 1 Chronicles 7:34.
familyAndRelationships: Jehubbah is explicitly identified as the son of Shomer, establishing a clear father-son relationship. No other family relationships are documented in Scripture beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jehubbah's significance lies in his inclusion within the genealogical records of the tribe of Asher, emphasizing the preservation of Israel's tribal lineages. His mention as Shomer's son helps maintain the continuity of the tribe's ancestry, which holds importance for understanding God's covenant people in the Old Testament.
